😐 Jensen Huang: China is no longer catching up in AI. In many fields, it has become advanced.

Nvidia's CEO said it clearly:

"50% of the world's AI researchers are Chinese."

"70% of AI patents last year were published in China."

"China's AI ecosystem is vibrant, rich, and unbelievably innovative."

"Nine of the top ten science and technology schools in the world are now in China."

"We used to lead most of these fields. Now they lead most of them."

The statement from the man who sells chips to both sides. And the message is clear: The race is no longer one-sided.
